# Claude Code Skills: Frontmatter

The frontmatter is the block of keys at the top of a `SKILL.md` file.
It sets the name, the description, the tools that the skill may use, and who may call it.
For example, `disable-model-invocation: true` makes a skill that only you can start.
The marks are explained on [Skills and Commands](Claude-Code-Skills-And-Commands).

## Rules

- The frontmatter is read only when the first line is `---`.
  A YAML error loads the skill with no fields (warning `[skills] YAML frontmatter ... failed to parse and was ignored`).
- Keys are case exact.
  An unknown key is ignored without an error.
- Booleans accept `true`, `false`, `yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `1`, `0` in any case (v2.1.218 or later).
- A top-level `PreToolUse` or `PermissionRequest` key outside `hooks` is an error.
  The skill then loads with no hooks and no `allowed-tools`.
- The description is the first line of the body when `description` is missing (heading marks removed, 100 characters at most).

## Keys

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `name` | Command name. | Defaults to the directory name. 256 characters at most. | Skill, plugin skill. Not command files. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `description` | Tells Claude when to use the skill. | Number and boolean values become strings. Text is cut at 1,536 characters in the listing. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `when_to_use` | More trigger text. | Appended to `description`. Counts to the 1,536 cap. The only key with an underscore. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `argument-hint` | Autocomplete hint. | Text, for example `[issue-number]`. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `arguments` | Names for `$name` placeholders. | A space string or a YAML list. Numeric-only names are dropped. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `disable-model-invocation` | Blocks automatic loading by Claude. | Also blocks preload into subagents and scheduled-task use. | All. | [Commands](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/commands), [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `user-invocable` | `false` hides the skill from the `/` menu. | Default `true`. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `allowed-tools` | Tools allowed without a prompt for the turn. | Space or comma string, or a list. The grant clears at your next message. Ignored under `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` (v2.1.282). `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` works in Bash rules. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `disallowed-tools` | Removes tools while the skill is active. | Same format. Bundle also reads the camel form `disallowedTools`. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `model` | Model for the turn. | `inherit` keeps the active model. A model outside `availableModels` is not used. With `context: fork` it sets the subagent model. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ⚠️ | `effort` | Effort level for the turn. | Docs: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. Bundle also accepts an integer, and warns "Valid options: ... or an integer". | All. | bundle `has invalid effort`, [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `context` | `fork` runs the skill in a subagent. | Any other value is ignored. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `agent` | Subagent type for `context: fork`. | Default `general-purpose`. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `background` | `false` waits for the forked result. | Default `true`. v2.1.218 or later. | All. | [Commands](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/commands), [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `hooks` | Hooks that start when the skill runs. | Last for the session. See [Hooks](Claude-Code-Hooks). | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `paths` | Glob limit for automatic loading. | A trailing `/**` is removed. A list of only `**` means no limit. | Skills only. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `shell` | Shell for `` !`cmd` `` blocks. | `bash` or `powershell`. Other values warn and fall back to bash. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `metadata` | Free map for your tools. | Dropped when it is not a map. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `license` | Agent Skills spec field. | Accepted, no effect. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `compatibility` | Agent Skills spec field. | String up to 500 characters. No effect. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `version` | Skill version text. | Read as a string into the command object. Not in the docs table. | Skill, plugin command. | [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
| ✅ | `fallback` | A boolean read by the loader. | Parsed with the boolean rule. | Skill. | - |
| 🔍 | `created_by`, `improved_by` | Mark a skill as made by the `dream-proposal` flow. | Only the value `dream-proposal` counts. Env `CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL_PROPOSALS` exists. | Skill. | bundle `createdBy` |
| ✅ | `experimental` | Map whose key names are recorded. | Only the key names go into `declaredFields`. | Skill. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |

## Outside Claude Code

claude.ai uploads and the Skills API accept only `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, and `allowed-tools`.
Other keys fail the upload.
Source: [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills).
